purpose: Freeze the positive per-column allowlist, strata and statistic plan used by factory/scripts/basket_tape_atlas_inspect.py to produce the outcome-blind corpus report of PLAN-TAPE-ATLAS.md section 2 (Stage 0C). It declares what may be READ and COUNTED; it freezes no representation, metric, weight, threshold, gate, distance or outcome, and it may not be read as a finding.

output.note: counts are exact; numeric quantiles are estimated from a bounded deterministic subsample with a reported binomial CI

read_inputs.manifest: --manifest: the immutable node manifest (payload_sha256 paths/sha256/rows, parents, core_hash). Payloads are resolved from it; nothing is globbed for reading, and rows are scanned one day-partition at a time.
read_inputs.schema: factory/artifacts/basket/phase2/ATLAS/TAPE/OBSERVATION/v0/schema.json (declared fields, dtypes, namespaces, coordinate_only / prospective_allowed / retrospective_only, supportable_by_tier)
read_inputs.guard_day: factory/scripts/basket_sim.py:guard_day — every payload day is guarded before its path is opened
read_inputs.dev_days: factory/scripts/basket_sim.py:dev_days — the manifest day set is compared with the canonical calendar (report only; no globbing)
read_inputs.no_legacy_panel: no outcome panel, panel.parquet, basket_atlas_panel or outcome/censor namespace is imported, read or derived anywhere in this inspection

enforce.numeric_rules: a numeric-summary column must be prospective_allowed, not retrospective_only, not coordinate_only, not provenance/censor/quality; keys, coordinates and masks follow the same namespace and flag rules. Hash, provenance, censor and whole-day quality columns are excluded from every numeric summary.
enforce.physical_deny_audit: each scanned payload's physical schema is checked against the causal registry deny vocabulary; a denied column name refuses the run before any row is read
enforce.path_rules: payload paths must be relative, traversal-free, resolve inside --root, and carry a guard_day-clean day inside the manifest day set

refusals.contract: illegal allowlist / hash mismatch / denied physical column / sealed day (no report is written)
refusals.integrity: declared payload absent, row-count or sha256 mismatch, parent drift (report is written with status REFUSED and exit code 3)

sampling.method: splitmix64 hash of (partition salt, row index) thresholded at reservoir_rows/declared_rows; a layer whose scanned rows are <= reservoir_rows is exact

derived_strata.feed_era: day_registry.feed_era for that day (day map sourced from the day_registry payload)
derived_strata.note: reported for every layer as by_strata; a physical block/month/feed_era coordinate is reported under by_coordinate and not duplicated

rank_change.note: consecutive-minute rank change inside a name; population/staleness/change distributions only, no outcome

rarity.note: rare/low-density candidate preservation counts: how many OBSERVED rows carry raw magnitude or raw activity at or above the frozen thresholds, by layer and block. No future tail label (tail_class_*, final_high_flag, remaining_run, cost_of_waiting, bars_to_*) is read or derived: these are density facts about the observed tape, not outcome strata.

identity_derivation.shared_vs_independent_paths: derived from memberships.path_id (a prospective key): distinct path_ids = tape paths carrying at least one membership; a path with >1 membership is a shared path; memberships_on_shared_paths and max_memberships_per_path come from the same tally. The paths table's own whole-day aggregates (n_memberships, families, membership_ids, last_entry_et, max_entry_rank) are retrospective_only after the PrefixBoundaryAudit fix (a later re-entry changes them - exactly the shared-path disclosure) and are NOT read; the paths payload still contributes its exact row count and the prospective anchors day/ticker/first_entry_et/min_entry_rank/session_end.
identity_derivation.declared_cross_check: compared with contract.json identity.expected_panel_census (paths 5905, memberships 6160, shared_paths 255)

whole_day_aggregates_excluded.rule: schema.json is the flag source of truth: retrospective_only=true or prospective_allowed=false means whole-day/future-derived, so the column may not enter any stratum or numeric summary here; it is listed under unobservable with that reason.
whole_day_aggregates_excluded.note: day_registry.built is provenance namespace and is likewise never read; canary_member (the frozen 20-day selection) is read only as an audit coordinate and is not a substitute for built.

computed: any fitted parameter or one-shot numeric gate
prohibited.note: the report is a census of the observed tape; it selects nothing and kills nothing
